name: visual-learner
description: Interactive visual learning from PDFs — powered by AI

scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:electron
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && pyinstaller main.py --name visual-learner-backend --distpath dist
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.test:coverage: cd frontend && vitest run --coverage && cd ../backend && pytest --cov
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.lint:frontend: cd frontend && vue-tsc --noEmit && eslint src/**/*.{ts,vue} && prettier --check src/**/*.{ts,vue,css,json}
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && black --check . && isort --check . && mypy app/
scripts.format: npm run format:frontend && npm run format:backend
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt
